build_attention_module: build a multi-head attention module with configurable heads, QKV bias, and dropout rates
create_attention_with_rope: create an Attention instance with rotary positional embeddings for transformer models
run_attention_forward: run the Attention forward pass on a tensor with optional positional encoding
review_attention_fused_attn: review the Attention class fused attention mode using F.scaled_dot_product_attention
refactor_attention_qk_norm: refactor the Attention module to enable or disable Q and K normalization
